function.name: UNLOAD_FPG
function.abstract: It unloads the memory occupied by a FPG library

description.p: It unloads the memory occupied by a FPG library and all graphs that the library contains. The library can have been created by , or recovered of disk by .
Any change made by functions like or , or any change made independently to graphs inside of library, it will be lost if before calling to this function, the archive has not been saved in disk by .
